Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the informative demo and for walking through your architecture/requirements — helpful context. Per our call, the best next step on the security side is to initiate the SIG questionnaire so your security team can review our controls and evidence.

I've attached a filled starter pack (redwood_SIG_starter.pdf) with our standard answers for common SIG items plus a short SLA summary (redwood_sla_summary.pdf). A few notes up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (available on NDA).
- Data residency: We can pin inference to US regions; EU options available by request.
- HIPAA: Supported with BAAs for customers processing PHI.

Could you confirm the primary security contact and whether your team prefers the SIG online portal or a spreadsheet export? Also, if there are any custom questions beyond SIG/CAIQ, please flag them and I’ll loop in our security engineer, Camila.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm primary contact / preferred format by EOD tomorrow.
2) We share the completed SIG starter + DocuSign link for any paperwork (NDA/BAA) if needed.
3) We schedule a short follow-up (20–30 min) with Camila for any deep-dive questions.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole

> 1) SOC 2 Type II: latest period covers 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31. We host the report under NDA; if helpful I can send a summary PDF this week and start the NDA/DocuSign flow.
> 2) BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA for both Hosted API and Dedicated deployments; our legal/security team has an addendum that covers PHI processing controls. If PulsePoint intends to send PHI, we recommend Dedicated or VPC deployment — we can discuss tradeoffs.
> 3) SIG portal: yes, we accept SIG submissions in the online portal. Camila will add Maya (maya.patel@pulsepointhealth.com) as a user and initiate the invite — Camila, can you confirm ETA on the invite?
